headline: Angola central bank cuts main interest rate to 14%
summary: Angola's central bank lowered its main interest rate from 14.75% to 14%, marking a 10-year low as domestic inflation continues to slow.
why: Lower interest rates are typically implemented to stimulate economic activity when inflation pressures subside.

impacts.name: Angola policy rate
impacts.why: The central bank reduced the rate by 75 basis points.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The decision follows a trend of slowing inflation in the country.
